/** Walk every page, for the export job. */
export function walk(rows, limit = 2) {
  const out = []
  let cursor
  for (;;) {
    const result = page({ rows, cursor, limit })
    out.push(...result.items)
    if (!result.hasMore) return out
    cursor = result.nextCursor
  }
}

/** Quote a field when it needs it. */
export function quoteField(value) {
  const text = String(value ?? '')
  if (/[",\r\n]/.test(text)) return '"' + text.replace(/"/g, '""') + '"'
  return text
}

/** Render rows as CSV text. */
export function toCsv(rows) {
  return rows.map((row) => row.map(quoteField).join(',')).join('\n') + '\n'
}

/** The first row read as the header, the rest as objects. */
export function parseRecords(text) {
  const rows = parseCsv(text).filter((row) => row.length > 1 || row[0] !== '')
  if (!rows.length) return []
  const [header, ...body] = rows
  return body.map((row) => Object.fromEntries(header.map((key, i) => [key, row[i] ?? ''])))
}

/** Quote a field when it needs it. */
export function quoteField(value) {
  const text = String(value ?? '')
  if (!/[",\r\n]/.test(text)) return text
  return '"' + text.replace(/"/g, '""') + '"'
}

/** Render rows as CSV text. */
export function toCsv(rows) {
  return rows.map((row) => row.map(quoteField).join(',')).join('\n') + '\n'
}

/** The first row read as the header, the rest as objects. */
export function parseRecords(text) {
  const rows = parseCsv(text).filter((row) => row.length > 1 || row[0] !== '')
  if (!rows.length) return []
  const [header, ...body] = rows
  return body.map((row) => Object.fromEntries(header.map((key, i) => [key, row[i] ?? ''])))
}

ort function addDays(iso, days) {
  const date = parseIsoDate(iso)
  if (!date) throw new Error('not an ISO date: ' + iso)

  const year = date.getUTCFullYear()
  const month = date.getUTCMonth() + 1
  const day = date.getUTCDate() + days

  return (
    String(year).padStart(4, '0') +
    '-' +
    String(month).padStart(2, '0') +
    '-' +
    String(Math.min(day, daysInMonth(year, month))).padStart(2, '0')
  )
}
    after: /**
 * Add `days` to an ISO date using UTC calendar arithmetic. The Date setter
 * handles month lengths, leap years, and year boundaries in both directions.
 *
 * @param {string} iso
 * @param {number} days may be negative
 */
export function addDays(iso, days) {
  const date = parseIsoDate(iso)
  if (!date) throw new Error('not an ISO date: ' + iso)

  date.setUTCDate(date.getUTCDate() + days)
  return toIso(date)
}
